predictions.articleTitle: Crewe vs Rochdale Prediction & Match Analysis: Unbeaten Hosts Face Depleted Dale — Scoreline & xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Crewe Alexandra's unbeaten defensive solidity and complete squad health will overcome a severely depleted Rochdale side missing multiple defensive and attacking starters, securing a disciplined 2:0 or 1:0 home victory.
possibilityAssessment: Crewe control tempo and exploit Rochdale defensive injuries for a clean-sheet victory (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Under 2.5 Goals supported by Crewe's elite 0.70 concession rate and Dale's missing forward line (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Second-half breakthrough following initial Rochdale low-block resistance (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Unbeaten Crewe host injury-ravaged Dale aiming to cement automatic promotion spot.

spf.comment: Crewe's unbeaten 10-match league record and elite defense face a Rochdale squad missing nine first-team regulars.

over_under.comment: Crewe concede only 0.70 goals per game while Rochdale are missing their primary goal threats Rodney and Smith.

score.comment: A controlled 2:0 victory or a tight 1:0 clean-sheet grind represent the two most probable game states.

goals.comment: Scoring volume is restricted by Rochdale's defensive retreat and lack of offensive counter-threat.

bqc.comment: Rochdale may resist through the opening 45 minutes before Crewe's superior depth breaks through in the second half.
